name: Embedding
description: Convert text into vectors using a configured OpenAI-compatible embedding provider.

inputs.name: text
inputs.label: Input Text(s)
inputs.placeholder: Enter text or wire {{nodes.chunker.chunks}} (optional if Artifact ID is provided)
inputs.helpText: Single text or array of strings. If omitted, text is loaded directly from the linked Artifact.

inputs.name: artifactId
inputs.label: Artifact ID
inputs.helpText: Optional Artifact ID to connect and persist embeddings out-of-band in the vector store.

inputs.name: logicalId
inputs.label: Artifact Logical ID
inputs.helpText: Optional stable logical artifact identity for tracking across versions.

inputs.name: namespace
inputs.label: Namespace
inputs.helpText: Vector namespace for storage and retrieval scoping.

inputs.name: includeRawVectors
inputs.label: Include Raw Vectors in State
inputs.helpText: When linked to an artifact, defaults to false to prevent graph state bloat. Set true only if downstream nodes require the raw float array.
